images.caption:
Map of the en:Vliet, made in the context of a conflict that played for the congregations of Rijnland in 1556. It went between Leiden and the crafts along the Vliet, with the navigability of the Vliet as its subject. On the map the so-called "bets" (eligible places) and depths are indicated. (map part 5; De Vliet to Leiden)
